facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that Lesotho's MICSTI is introducing the Electronic Transactions and Communications Bill, 2026, a revision of the 2022 bill of the same name, after a two-day stakeholder validation workshop held with UNDP that week; the draft goes next to the Office of the Parliamentary Counsel for refinement (as_of is the article's published date, 2026-09-30, the workshop being 'this week').

The ministry states, per ITWeb Africa, that Lesotho lacks a legal and regulatory framework for electronic transactions, creating uncertainty for government, businesses and consumers over electronic contracts, signatures, records, online services and digital commerce (as_of is the article's published date, 2026-09-30).
